zh: 加完前 i 个元素后的累计值等于初值 x 加上前 i 个元素的前缀和，所以所有约束都可以写成“x + 某个前缀和 ≥ 1”。
这些约束里最紧的一条来自最小的前缀和 minPrefix。只要 x + minPrefix ≥ 1，其余前缀自然也满足；而 x 还必须是正数。
令前缀和 s 与 minPrefix 都从 0 开始（把空前缀算作 0 恰好保证 x ≥ 1）；逐个加入元素并更新 minPrefix = min(minPrefix, s)；输出 1 − minPrefix。前缀和最多约 10^11，用 64 位整数。
en: After adding the first i elements, the running value equals the initial x plus the prefix sum of those i elements, so every constraint reads x + (some prefix sum) >= 1.
The tightest of these constraints comes from the smallest prefix sum minPrefix. Once x + minPrefix >= 1, all other prefixes are fine too; x must also be positive.

Start both the prefix sum s and minPrefix at 0 (counting the empty prefix as 0 is exactly what forces x >= 1); add the elements one by one and update minPrefix = min(minPrefix, s); print 1 - minPrefix. Prefix sums reach about 10^11, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the minimum minPrefix over all prefix sums. The initial value x must satisfy x+minPrefix≥1, so the answer is 1−minPrefix.

## Proof of correctness

The running sum after each step equals x plus the corresponding prefix sum. All running sums are at least 1 if and only if x≥1−minPrefix; that value itself satisfies the constraint, and anything one smaller fails at the minimum prefix.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(1) space.
